scope: Descriptive reanalysis of existing complete historical IPMSM and Paderborn predictions; no fits, hyperparameter selection, formal tests, or new confirmation.
inclusion: Every configured non-training profile in each dataset. Exact source-row alignment and archived hashes must pass before calculation.
decomposition: With e=P-y and c=L-P, MSE(L)-MSE(P)=2 mean(e*c)+mean(c*c). Both terms and row-wise improvement fractions are reported; no causal interpretation.
range_reference: Original measured raw variables at actual fitting endpoints (row300 onward, stride5); held ranges use every evaluated row300 onward. Include full raw training ranges separately. No cross-dataset pooling.
exceedance: Observed marginal min-max and 5th-95th percentile ranges are descriptive support checks, not multivariate out-of-distribution detectors or inferential thresholds.

figure_selection.success: Paderborn own_boundary historical evaluation: among profiles with linear_residual-minus-matched_direct RMSE<0, select smallest absolute distance to the median difference of the entire14-profile cohort; break ties by lower profile ID.
figure_selection.failure: IPMSM own_boundary historical evaluation: select largest linear_residual-minus-matched_direct RMSE among both profiles; break ties by lower profile ID.
figure_selection.interpretation: Illustrative selected records with explicit outcome-based rules, not prospective or representative sampling. Every eligible profile remains in CSV summaries.
figure_selection.x_axis: Original source-row index, avoiding an unverified IPMSM physical sampling interval.

claim_limits: Observed operating-range shifts or correction directions do not establish why motor datasets differ; they describe failure patterns under existing fits. Historical data exposure is unchanged.

_public_view.transformation: JSON reserialization with this provenance notice; scientific values and original historical receipt hashes retained. Source-record paths are relative and refer to private archived inputs, not bundled raw data.
_public_view.receipt_scope: Historical archival record, not evidence that the current portable release script was executed. Current release checks are recorded separately in provenance/validation-v007.json.
